info.title: Project planner service
info.description:
The Project Planner Service helps people who are new to ADSP describe a business problem and
turn it into a plan for using ADSP services.

The planner builds a structured _business model_ of the problem (actors, goals, workflows, rules, constraints,
assumptions, unknowns, etc.), matches it against known GoA _business patterns_, and derives one or more
_solution hypotheses_ that recommend ADSP services. Each recommended service has a _specialist_ that can be consulted
for service-specific questions and dependencies, and links to its service workspace.

A _solution_ is the persistent, structured state of this work: decisions made (and why), open questions,
specialist progress, and recommended next steps. It survives across sessions so the user does not need
to repeat information already gathered.

Any recommendation made by the planner is a hypothesis for the user to refine.

get.description: Retrieves the analysis modes available, the default mode, and the configured model name. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token.

post.summary: Extracts a problem statement from a document.
post.description: Extracts the text of an uploaded document, to use as a problem statement. Supports Markdown (.md, .markdown), Word (.docx, and .doc HTML exports such as Confluence "Export to Word") and PDF (.pdf) files up to 20 MB. The file isn't stored. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token. Responds 400 if no file is uploaded, the format isn't supported, or no text can be read from the file.

file.description: The document, in the `file` field. Must be no larger than 20 MB.

get.description: Retrieves the effective business pattern catalogue of the tenant: built-in patterns, overridden by patterns in the tenant's configuration, overridden by patterns stored through this API. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token.

post.description: Creates a custom business pattern in the tenant of the token. Requires the planner-admin role. The `id` is optional and defaults to a slug of the name; responds 400 if a pattern with the ID already exists.

post.description: Matches free text against the tenant's effective pattern catalogue and explains the confidence of each match. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token.

example.text: Caseworkers manage cases from intake to decision.

200.description: Ranked pattern matches, with clarifying questions when confidence is low.

get.description: Retrieves a pattern from the tenant's effective pattern catalogue. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token.

put.description: Updates a pattern of the tenant of the token. Updating a built-in or configured pattern stores a tenant copy that overrides it. Requires the planner-admin role. The `patternId` must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,59}$`.

strongSignals.description: Staff work cases through a lifecycle

delete.summary: Deletes a pattern stored through the API.
delete.description: Deletes a custom pattern of the tenant of the token, or restores a customized built-in pattern to its built-in version. Built-in and configured patterns themselves can't be deleted and respond 400. Requires the planner-admin role.

get.description: Retrieves solutions of the tenant of the token, most recently updated first. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role. Users with planner-user see the solutions they created; planner-admin sees all solutions in the tenant.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor of the page to read, from `page.next` of the previous response.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only include solutions with this status.

post.description: Creates a draft solution in the tenant of the token, owned by the calling user. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role. Sends a `solution-created` event.

example.name: Small business grant
example.description: Online applications for the small business grant.
example.problemStatement: Applicants apply for a small business grant. Staff review each application and decide.

get.description: Retrieves a solution, including its structured state. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token. Only the user who created the solution, or a planner-admin, can retrieve it; other users receive 403. Solutions of other tenants respond 404.

patch.description: Updates solution details, concepts, decisions (with their reasons), and questions. Lists replace the existing list; items without an `id` are given one. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin. Sends a `solution-updated` event and saves a new version when the content changed, unless `checkpoint` is false. Each item of `concepts`, `decisions`, and `questions` must be an object.

problemStatement.description: Changing the problem statement refreshes the solution's confidence.

decidedOn.description: Defaults to the time of the request.

decidedBy.description: Defaults to the name of the calling user.

decisions.title: Applicant sign-in
decisions.decision: Applicants sign in with Alberta.ca Account.
decisions.reason: Applicants need to return to saved drafts.

delete.description: Deletes a solution and its saved versions. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and only the user who created the solution can delete it; other users, including planner-admin, receive 403. Sends a `solution-deleted` event.

post.description: Extracts concepts, matches patterns, and generates hypotheses and next steps for the problem statement. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin. Responds 400 if neither `text` nor the solution has a problem statement. Sends a `solution-updated` event.

text.description: Problem statement to analyze; replaces the solution's. Defaults to the solution's problem statement.

example.text: Applicants apply for a small business grant. Staff review each application and decide.

post.description: Generates the complete project blueprint: architecture, ADSP service mapping, components to set up, specialist notes, workflows, data and governance, delivery, and acceptance criteria. Saved consultations are reused. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin. Responds 400 if the solution hasn't been analyzed. Sends `solution-updated` events.

refreshConsultations.description: Run fresh specialist consultations instead of reusing saved ones.

post.summary: Sends a message to the planner about a solution.
post.description: Sends a message to the planner. The analysis is refined using the message, the answers, and the conversation so far, and the message and the planner's reply are appended to `state.conversation`. The response is the updated solution as JSON, not a stream. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin. Sends a `solution-updated` event.

example.message: Applicants can also appeal a decision.

200.description: The solution with the refined analysis and the reply in state.conversation.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The component's order in the blueprint.

put.summary: Records the review of a blueprint component.
put.description: Records the user's review of a blueprint component. Rejected components are left out of the export. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin. Responds 404 if the blueprint has no component with the order. Sends a `solution-updated` event.

200.description: The solution with the component's review updated.

post.summary: Consults a service specialist about a solution.
post.description: Consults a service specialist about fit, questions, dependencies, and risks, and records the exchange in the caller's chat with the specialist. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin. Responds 404 for an unknown specialist, and 400 when the chat is full (200 messages). Sends a `solution-updated` event.

proposal.description: A plan for the specialist to validate.

example.question: Can applicants save a draft and return later?

200.description: Consultation result and the updated solution.

post.description: Advances the discovery conversation. The planner replies with clarifying questions and scores six factors; the solution is analyzed and presented once confidence reaches 75% and every factor is at least 40%, or when `force` is set. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin. Responds 400 if the solution has no problem statement. Sends a `solution-updated` event.

message.description: The user's reply to the planner's questions. Trimmed before validation.

force.description: Present the solution regardless of confidence.

restart.description: Clear the discovery thread and start over.

example.message: Small businesses apply online. Program staff review and approve each application.

200.description: The solution with state.discovery and state.confidence updated.

get.description: Downloads the current solution as a JSON attachment (`Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="planner-{id}.json"`), including unsaved changes and the user's specialist chats about it. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin.

get.summary: Retrieves the saved versions of a solution.
get.description: Retrieves the saved versions of a solution, newest first, and whether the solution has unsaved changes. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin.

post.summary: Saves a version of a solution.
post.description: Saves a new version of the solution if it changed since the latest saved version; otherwise returns the latest version. Use it after a series of calls made with `checkpoint` false. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin. Sends a `solution-updated` event when a version is saved.

patch.description: Renames a saved version of a solution. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin. Responds 404 if the version doesn't exist. Sends a `solution-updated` event.

name.description: New name, trimmed. An empty name resets it to `Version {number}`.

get.summary: Downloads a saved version of a solution.
get.description: Downloads a saved version as a JSON attachment (`Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="planner-{id}-v{number}.json"`). Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token, and the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin. Responds 404 if the version doesn't exist.
Retrieves the service specialists known to the planner. The list is the same for every tenant. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token.

get.summary: Lists the caller's saved specialist chats.
get.description: Lists the specialist chats of the calling user in the tenant of the token. Chats are private: planner-admin doesn't see other users' chats. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role.

Downloads the full history of the calling user's specialist chats as a JSON attachment (`Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="planner-specialist-chats.json"`). Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token.
Retrieves a saved chat of the calling user, with its full history. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token. Chats of other users respond 404.

delete.description: Deletes a saved chat of the calling user. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token. Chats of other users respond 404.

get.description: Downloads a saved chat of the calling user as a JSON attachment (`Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="planner-chat-{chatId}.json"`). Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token. Chats of other users respond 404.

post.summary: Converses directly with a service specialist.
post.description: Converses with a service specialist (ask, recommend, design, validate, or sample code), without a planner session. The exchange is saved to the caller's chat history, which is private to the caller. Requires the planner-user or planner-admin role in the tenant of the token. With `solutionId`, the user must have created the solution or be a planner-admin. Responds 404 for an unknown specialist, chat, or solution, and 400 when the chat belongs to another specialist or is full (200 messages).

chatId.description: Continue a saved chat; omit to start a new one.

solutionId.description: Give the specialist the context of a solution. Ignored when the chat has a solution.
